item.title: The Hoppers hype is REAL! Shop the top new Disney & Pixar merch, featuring Mabel and the whole crew
item.description: Get ready for the next big Pixar adventure with our top picks from the Hoppers collection, the best tees, plushies, and exclusive merch for fans of the pond crew.

item.title: Residents upset over giant warehouse turning into ICE detention center in NJ community
item.description: A big push is now underway to try to stop the Trump Administration from converting a warehouse in New Jersey into a new ICE detention center.

item.title: Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery announce $110 billion deal
item.description: A massive $110 billion merger has been signed between Warner Bros Discovery and Paramount Skydance.

item.title: AccuWeather: Fog to near 50 degrees
item.description: Saturday brings the best weather of the stretch. Patchy fog may develop early in the morning, but once it burns off, expect mostly sunny skies and highs near 50.

item.title: Man accused of poisoning Southern California couple by spraying bug spray on food
item.description: A couple is speaking out after their roommate allegedly poisoned them, leading to a standoff with deputies. Video shows the man spraying bug spray on their groceries.

item.title: 9 men indicted in 17‑Day crime spree from Long Island to Florida
item.description: Nine people have been charged in a wild crime spree that extended from Long Island to Westchester County to Florida.

item.title: PATH service in and out of Hoboken, NJ resumes after track fire
item.description: PATH service in and out of Hoboken has resumed after being suspended earlier Friday following a track fire.

item.title: One of the oldest Italian restaurants in the Theatre District closes
item.description: Some would argue that its allure is the space - from its antique cash register to its chandelier purchased from a royal Italian family, it is a restaurant tucked inside a museum.

item.title: Disaster as fencing wire gets tangled in spinning car wash in North Carolina
item.description: The first rule of going to the car wash with your truck is make sure there's nothing in the bed. A North Carolina man found that out the hard way.

item.title: Israel's defense minister says his country has attacked Iran and declares a state of emergency
item.description: Israel launched a daylight attack Saturday on Iran's capital, with a cloud of smoke rising from the city's downtown.
